bullets: Current relevance: the 2026 El Niño drought has made the Irrigation Calendar a priority, with Veligonda Phase-I commissioned on 31 Aug 2026 (TH).
Criticism & debates: solar pumps may drive groundwater over-draw. Evidence suggests outcomes depend on the local hydrogeology (TH, 20 Aug 2026).

sections.where: Prep notes · Book 3 Economy › C-3 › Indian agriculture - importance, land use classification, cropping seasons and cropping pattern › Universal angles
bullets: Current relevance: El Niño hit the 2026 kharif. AP had a 51% rainfall deficit from 1 June to 25 August, and all 28 districts were in deficit. 20.35 lakh ha was sown, against 25.63 lakh ha a year earlier (TH, 28 Aug 2026).
AP angle: the survey's list of constraints is fragmented holdings (below 1 ha), monsoon dependence, soil-fertility loss and weak credit (APSES; CDI).
Criticism & debates: heavy monsoon dependence. About 50% of net sown area is rainfed and 86% of holdings are under 2 ha (LENSD, 8 Jun 2026).
AP rainfall 51% below normal (India 13%) to 25 Aug; sown area 20.35 lakh ha vs 25.63 lakh ha last year, with a planned shift to pulses and drought-resilient crops (TH, 28 Aug 2026).
AP angle: paddy dominates AP foodgrains (20.97 of 37.51 lakh ha in 2024-25); AP holdings are smaller than the national average (0.86 ha, 2021-22).

sections.where: Prep notes · Book 4 Geography › D-1 › Climate change - evidence, natural and anthropogenic causes, global warming, IPCC assessments, impacts › Impacts
bullets: Sea level: thermal expansion plus ice melt; uninhabited South Pacific islets Tebua Tarawa and Abanuea submerged in 1999; Kiribati, Tuvalu at risk (APP).

Coral bleaching: the 1.2 degC threshold for large-scale warm-water reef collapse is already crossed; beyond ~2 degC parts of the Amazon may turn savanna (UN brief, LENSD 24 Jun 2026). Reefs need 15+ years to recover (APP).
Oceans and species: acidity up 30% since the Industrial Revolution (CDI); up to 25% of mountain species face extinction (AR6, CDI).

Extremes and agriculture: India 2025 - 4,419 deaths and 17.4 million ha of crops damaged by extreme weather (WMO 2025, CDI); buffalo milk yields in Haryana's trans-Gangetic plains hit by warming (TH, 6 Jul 2026).
Disease spread: warmer, wetter conditions widen the range of vector-borne diseases such as malaria and dengue.

sections.where: Prep notes · Book 3 Economy › C-3 › Minimum Support Price - mechanism, CACP, crops covered, procurement, criticism; PM-AASHA › Procurement - open-ended vs limited procurement crops, decentralised procurement states, AP paddy procurement system
bullets: Wheat and paddy: FCI and State agencies buy all stock that meets specifications at MSP, so procurement is effectively open-ended. Coarse grains: States procure with GoI's prior approval (IYB 2026). Pulses, oilseeds and copra: limited PSS procurement (25% cap).
Wheat RMS 2026-27: >35 MT procured (+17%), above the 34.5 MT target (30 MT the year before). Punjab 12.1 MT and MP 10.4 MT led. Output was 120.65 MT (TH, 4 Jun 2026).
Decentralised Procurement (DCP), 1997: States procure, store and distribute; the Centre reimburses economic cost minus CIP (UPSC notes).

AP: State agencies procure paddy for FCI's Central Pool under the Paddy Procurement Scheme. DBT to farmers is due within a 48-hour window (APPCA Mar 2026; APSES 2024-25). DCMS societies procure so that farmers actually get MSP. APMARKFED is the apex cooperative marketing body (APSES 2024-25).

bullets: Women's political reservation was first constitutionally institutionalized through the 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendment Acts, 1992.

Women's reservation in the Legislative Assembly of the National Capital Territory of Delhi covers Scheduled Caste-reserved seats.
Not less than one-third of the total seats reserved for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes under Article 243D(2) must be reserved for women belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
The mandatory sub-quota for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe women within Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe reserved seats is one-third.
